notes.title: Pastures New - Patch 0.0.1.15
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We’ve been working hard since the start of January on fixing lots of bugs of varying sizes. This latest patch has taken a little longer than we’d have expected as we upgraded our engine version from Unreal 5.4 to 5.5. This itself gave us some unexpected issues however we are now happy with everything to push this build live. 

The main feature you will notice is Mega Lights, which is a new Unreal method for rending dynamic lights, this means you can now splash lights down without it killing your performance. However this feature won’t be available for everyone as your systems will require hardware ray-tracing. This is an NVIDIA  RTX-2000 series or newer or an AMD RX-6000 series or newer. Sadly these are restrictions but on us by Unreal. If you don’t have these GPUs don’t worry as we still have all the dynamic lights working nicely and we’ve done some optimisations for them so they should perform better than before. We have also made the lights cover a much bigger area so hopefully you will require less of them to actually light your builds.

We’ve also adjusted a lot of the lighting and shadow settings so the game looks a lot nicer on lower settings. In addition to this we’ve done a lot of work to make the game look really nice even if you have to turn Lumen off. In fact some of you may now prefer the game without lumen.

You may also notice nights are a lot darker than before this is in preparation for creating the right atmosphere for the survival mode. If you find it too dark there is a brightness setting in the general tab in the graphic settings. You can also skip day with the P key (It may lag for a second or so and it's recommended you don’t move while pressing it, but it will skip night). 

There have also been some changes to the building system. Now when placing blocks they will snap to the closest snapping point. We’ve found this to feel a lot better, let us know what you think. This has also meant we’ve had to add an option to turn off snapping (which I know some of you wanted anyway) you will be able to see that in the building controls in the top left when your hammer is equipped.

We are still working hard on fixing snapping point issues and we are slowly fixing them all. However we have been prioritising working on new features.

Again if you have any feedback or problems don’t hesitate to pop us a message. 

Alex & Jon

notes.title: Pastures New - Patch 0.0.1.04
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Our last little update before the Christmas break. We’ve decided to do a little patch to add some tutorials for building with the hammer and terrain editing through the spade. These will appear when you first select these tools (so may not appear in existing saves if you’ve already used the tools). 

We hope you all like and approve of the additions and hopefully it will help everyone understand how the systems work as we definitely noticed a lot of players were getting slightly confused especially with snapping.

Also we’d like to thank Enixxx_ on twitch for doing the first stream of Pastures New (that we know of) last night on his Twitch channel.    

Finally we will be having a little break over the holidays so there won’t be any patches to the new year. However if you have any questions or problems please pop us a message on our discord server or on the Pastures New Community Hub and I’m sure one of us will get back to you reasonably quickly.

Merry Christmas and A Happy New Year
Alex & Jon

notes.title: Pastures New Patch 0.0.1.03
notes.content:
Hi again Everyone,

The first few days of the demo release have been crazy, thank you all for your feedback in both discussions and over in the discord.

We have been working tirelessly to fix the issues raised and make sure everyone enjoys their first experience of Pastures New.

[b]New Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Added plank & split log wall ridges
[/list]
[b]Building System Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added node guides on blocks
[*] Added match block key to allow players to quickly change their building block
[*] Amended snapping points
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Added missing sounds to pickaxe and rocks
[*] Added visible no build area around world locations
[*] Fixed glass blocks being invisible when placing
[*] Fixed screen resolution bug
[*] Fixed issue where player would be locked from building
[*] Amended UI elements
[*] Amended ghost building block materials to be more visible
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999912/5801d1d8a5d2effcb5cdf4f619b31bd61e2617d6.png[/img]

Again thank you for playing and please keep sending in your feedback and pictures of your buildings.

Alex & Jon

notes.title: Pastures New Creative Demo OUT NOW 🎉🎉🎉
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Welcome to Pastures New, we are proud to announce the release of our Creative Demo.

It's nice to see all the new faces appearing each day. And for the followers that have been here since day one, it's great to have you with us on our journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999912/162bd50d463b687654053510f564e032a78cf787.png[/img]

We are planning to keep you all updated with frequent social hub posts and with dev blogs at each major update. We want to hear your opinions so please don't hesitate to hop in our Discord or send us a message with your thoughts.

If you find any issues in the demo please please please join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/rtxSZwkCJH]discord [/url]and create a bug report. We test the game thoroughly but there are always things that slip past.

If you like what you see and want to keep updated with all of our news please wishlist Pastures New. Wishlisting lets us know just how much you guys like the game and allows us to get more love from steam.

Thank you for reading.

Alex & Jon
